claim_boundary: The 1.072x result is an early matched distributed launch-window measurement, not a completed-run aggregate.
All five samples are aligned by update and use the same data recipe, effective global batch, and worker topology.
The window ends at 1.678 billion tokens while learning-rate warmup continues to update 2000, so it does not establish convergence.
The stronger single-GB200 B4 result measures a controlled local timing bracket; distributed data, optimizer, and collective work dilute that local gain.
The NVFP4-projection plus MXFP4-PV arm is excluded from speedup claims because it diverged shortly after the initially matched region.
